version: v13 DRAFT 0.3, 2026-11-13 (after the independent audit; ADR-005)

document_metadata.voice_class: data/manifest/ISSUERS_<date>.csv (institutional, staff_authored, official_speech, ...): a document-level attribute, confirmed by the authors; a staff-authored document never establishes a commitment whatever its units say

L0_mention.strata_note: D, N, R are classified; X (fragments that are not dictionary hits, boilerplate links) is outside every denominator and is audited separately

model_only.modal_term: the modal word the model relied on, kept as a diagnostic for translated text; not coded by humans and not scored

changes_v0.3: status split into the contract's two axes (rule B): decision x implementation; REJECTED removed: a decided 'will not be offered' is an ENDORSED position with stance EXPOSES and the flag anonymity_rejected
direction renamed stance and defined from the user's side (PROTECTS / EXPOSES), so that granting access to an actor and requiring identification are no longer one value named GRANT
basis must be stated for the coded proposition itself; the strongest basis in the paragraph is no longer taken; naming a technique is not CRYPTOGRAPHIC unless it is said to deliver the property
OPERATIONAL means a live CBDC system; a law in force is basis LEGAL, not implementation OPERATIONAL
flags are three separate yes/no fields

PET_TECHNIQUE.note: basis is coded from the unit; naming a technique does not set CRYPTOGRAPHIC

PROGRAMMABILITY.note: not a privacy statement under L1; stays with F10

OTHER.note: mostly voice = REPORTED, or not relevant under L1

crosswalk_from_survey_types_2026-11-02.note: lossy and one-way: the 17 survey types cannot be recovered from the facets; direction values of v0.2 read RESTRICT -> PROTECTS, GRANT -> EXPOSES

derived.rule: talk labels are descriptive. No talk label sets, replaces or bypasses an F-cell; commitments come only from atomic claims under the contract (rules A, B, C).

nested_shares.U: eligible units of the fixed document set (all strata except X)
nested_shares.L: relevant units (L1), estimated with stratum weights (D and N weight 1, R weight 1/rate)
nested_shares.M: OWN units with basis LEGAL, ARCHITECTURAL or CRYPTOGRAPHIC
nested_shares.E: OWN units with decision ENDORSED or implementation OPERATIONAL (reported for all OWN units and, separately, within M)
nested_shares.reported: L/U, O/L, M/O, E/O and E/M with intervals; a ratio with a zero denominator is undefined; dictionary hits are a retrieval diagnostic, not a stage

derived.talk_against_commitment: per aspect with a matching cell, a 2 x 2 table of projects: at least one OWN relevant unit on the aspect (yes / no) x admissible commitment in the cell under rule C (yes / no), with the located units listed
derived.highest_rung: per project and aspect, the highest of: declaratory (basis NONE) < policy < legal or architectural or cryptographic basis < endorsed < operational; reported with the number of documents searched
derived.event_history: per project and aspect, the year of the first OWN unit, of the first OWN unit with a legal / architectural / cryptographic basis, of the first ENDORSED unit and of the first OPERATIONAL unit (MB, 13 Nov 2026: this is the year-by-year output per project)
derived.yearly_corpus_series: shares by year pooled over projects, with document-bootstrap intervals
not_reported: difference of a talk index and a commitment index
ranking of projects by amount of privacy talk
'silent' projects (reported instead: no OWN unit found in N documents searched, with the upper bound from the random control)
share of privacy units per project and year
derived.regulator_view: every table is reported by issuer type and document voice class; central bank, government and legislature are never pooled silently

context: the paragraph of the unit, rendered by scripts/units/context.py for coders and for the model alike

aspect_comparison_cells.ANONYMITY: none (general anonymity is neither F1 nor F4)
aspect_comparison_cells.note: pairs used ONLY to line up the 2 x 2 table of talk against commitment. An aspect label never establishes the cell: actor, data object, ordinary or exceptional access, payer or payee and design version are recorded in the atomic claims of the contract, not here.
